context:
Your ruling on item 51 could not run. The first test file was refused: the site's owner removed the past-days archive over server costs, with no workaround. The lane stopped there. Nothing was downloaded or installed.
TCGCSV's current prices are still open.

options.gain: Real sales with volume, one year back, for whole sets, free.
options.how: A builder lane adds every Riftbound card to the price-history sweep, which today covers only cards you held or sold.
options.label: Widen the price sweep to every Riftbound card
options.lose: One year only. The source slows it after about 800 requests, so it fills over days. A code change.

options.gain: A whole-market history, free, growing from today.
options.how: A daily job reads Riftbound's 14 groups (about 30 small requests) into a local table.
options.label: Read TCGCSV's current prices each day
options.lose: No past data. Months before it supports a backtest. No sales.

options.gain: A year of sales now, and listing history growing from today.
options.label: Both, the sweep first
Stop the backtest here
options.lose: Findings stay limited to your own cards.

ref: PR 964 (price-pattern research), D222 (the archive sweep paces itself)
title: TCGCSV's past-price archive is gone. Where should backtest history come from?
why: The sweep is the only large free past history left, and the daily read is the only route to whole-market listing data.
